SELECTED_INDEX: 1
CONFIDENCE: 0.55
EXPLANATION: Key experimental bands match a para-fluoro-acetophenone pattern.
• Strong 1686 cm⁻¹ band = conjugated carbonyl C=O stretch of an acetyl group.
• 1600 cm⁻¹ and 1509 cm⁻¹ = aromatic C=C stretches.
• Very strong 822 cm⁻¹ (with companion 839 cm⁻¹) = para-disubstituted benzene C–H out-of-plane deformation.
• Intense 1075 cm⁻¹ band is characteristic of an aromatic C–F stretch; only candidate 1 contains fluorine.
• 1268 cm⁻¹ and 1159 cm⁻¹ fit in-plane C–H bends and C–F related modes.
• High-frequency C–H stretches at 3081 and 3014 cm⁻¹ (aromatic) plus 2930 cm⁻¹ (methyl) agree with the CH groups in candidate 1.
Other candidates lack fluorine (or are not para-disubstituted aromatics), or contain strong S=O groups that would give dominant bands near 1150 & 1320 cm⁻¹ not observed with highest intensity. Therefore, CC(=O)c1ccc(F)cc1 (candidate 1) provides the most consistent match.
